description: A stacked bar chart showing the default tooltip indicator, a small colored square for each series.
overview: A stacked bar chart that shows the default tooltip indicator, a small colored square beside each series. It is the most compact indicator and the one you get without setting anything.
usage: Leave `indicator` unset or set it to `dot` on `ChartTooltipContent`. Replace `chartData` and the series in `chartConfig` with your own.
notes: The tooltip opens on a preset month when the chart loads; remove `defaultIndex` if it should start hidden.
